items.q:
Find the next term in the series:

3, 7, 15, 31, ?
items.explain: Each term is double the previous one plus 1 (the differences 4, 8, 16, 32 also double), so 31 x 2 + 1 = 63.

items.q: In a code language ROAD is written as SPBE. How is TAXI written in the same code?
items.explain: Every letter is shifted one place forward in the alphabet, so T-A-X-I becomes U-B-Y-J.

items.q: A 180 m long train passes a signal pole in 9 seconds. What is its speed?
items.explain: Speed = 180 / 9 = 20 m/s, and 20 x 18/5 = 72 km/h; 20 is correct only in m/s.

items.q:
Quarterly sales of a shop (in lakh):

Q1: 30  Q2: 45  Q3: 60  Q4: 65

What percentage of the year's sales came in Q3?
items.explain: Total = 200 lakh, so Q3 share = 60 / 200 = 30%; 32.5% is Q4's share.

items.q: Rahul walks 3 km north, then turns right and walks 4 km. How far is he from his starting point?
items.explain: North then east form a right angle, so the straight-line distance is sqrt(3^2 + 4^2) = 5 km; 7 km is the path length.

items.q: A shopkeeper sells a mixer for ₹4,600 and makes a 15% profit. What was the cost price?
items.explain: Selling price = 1.15 x cost, so cost = 4600 / 1.15 = ₹4,000; subtracting 15% of 4,600 gives the wrong 3,910.

items.q:
Which number does not belong in the group?

2, 3, 5, 9, 11, 13
items.explain: All the others are prime numbers; 9 = 3 x 3 is the only composite.

items.q: What is the simple interest on ₹50,000 at 8% per annum for 3 years?
items.explain: SI = P x R x T / 100 = 50,000 x 8 x 3 / 100 = ₹12,000; ₹12,986 would be compound interest.

items.q: For the question 'Tell me about a time you handled a conflict in a team', which line is the Result part of a STAR answer?
options: We shipped two days early and still pair on work today
I owned the backend, with a three-week deadline
I set up a call, listed trade-offs, and we chose together
In my final-year project two of us disagreed on the database design
items.explain: Situation sets the scene, Task states your responsibility, Action is what you personally did, and Result is the measurable outcome; interviewers mark you down when the Result is missing.

items.q: Interviewer asks: 'What is your biggest weakness?' Which answer is the weakest?
options: I was weak at SQL; after a course, joins are easy now
I am a perfectionist and I work too hard
I over-committed; now I confirm dates before saying yes
I avoided presenting; I joined a club and presented thrice
items.explain: A 'weakness' that is secretly a boast sounds rehearsed and tells the interviewer nothing; a real weakness plus the concrete step you took is what scores.

items.q: A candidate answers: 'In our project we built an app, we found a bug before the demo, we fixed it and we got an A.' What is the main thing missing?
options: How many marks the project carried
What the candidate personally did, in their own words
items.explain: Behavioural answers are judged on your individual action; an answer that says 'we' throughout never shows the interviewer what you can do.
